caption: The drawing depicts a single brass or gold-colored candle holder with a circular base that is wide, shallow, and slightly concave. The candle holder has a central vertical cylindrical shaft with two raised horizontal bands near the top and middle, as well as a round knob-shaped accent on the shaft. There is a flat, wide-rimmed lip at the very top for holding a candle. Attached to the left side of the base is a large, round handle with a small, pointed extension at its top. The object is rendered on a light beige or cream background and is outlined with a thin rectangular border. The drawing uses yellow, brown, and black tones to suggest the metallic texture and create shading, with a signature "A. Camilli" in the bottom right corner within the border.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
